note: Each member is reported as a percentile of its own live range, 0-100 (pct), with its direction in side; panel_pct (0-100) is the size of the mean of the signed percentiles and side its direction; panel_pct_sd their spread. The selection is 3 of 4 members in their own top 20% (consensus_k). panel_score is the signed median of the members' sizes, each read against its own recent history. consensus_k counts members that put the name in their own top 20% on the panel's side; that, not sign agreement, is what selected well on the development names. Certainty (p_up) is recorded and decides nothing. expected_edge_pct is a shrunk in-sample prior, not a forecast. Research only. Non-US stage: the hunters are the stage's own, the judges are panel-judge-intl-*, and expected_edge_pct is null because stage E-P's development prior was measured mostly on US names.
